rule: Nothing is published about another product until the Project Owner holds an account or trial of it, has read its terms, and has recorded here that those terms allow publishing a benchmark of it. public_scorecard.py refuses to render a benchmark result for any product other than whisper-face that has no such entry. No maker is contacted; they are free to rerun the benchmark themselves.

entry_fields.product_id: the identifier a result names, lower case
entry_fields.terms_read_on: ISO date the owner read the product's terms
entry_fields.terms_allow_publishing: true only when the owner judged that they do
entry_fields.recorded_by_owner: true; an agent never adds or edits an entry
